_note: The words clients see when they agree to texts. The booking form, the /text-messages/ page (proof of opt-in for Twilio) and the booking system all read them from here, so they can't drift apart.
appointmentConsent: By continuing, you agree to get texts from The Wax Room at this number about your appointments: confirmations, reminders, changes and receipts. Message frequency varies, usually 2 to 4 per visit. Message and data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help, STOP to opt out.
offersLabel: Text me offers and news from The Wax Room too (optional, not needed to book). Up to 4 a month. We’ll text you to confirm. Reply STOP anytime.
offersConfirm: The Wax Room: reply YES to get offers and news by text, up to 4 a month. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out.
offersWelcome: You’re in! Offers and news from The Wax Room, up to 4 a month. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help.
firstTextLine: The Wax Room: reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help.
